blurb: Premium Experiences Whistler offers a curated collection of luxury chalets with premium amenities such as private hot tubs, ski-in/ski-out access, gourmet kitchens, and concierge services. Guests can enjoy fully catered chalet experiences including private chefs, hosts, and customized itineraries. The company also provides luxury property management services for homeowners.

quotes.author: Susan Labuda
quotes.text: Great team and experience! We were new to the Whistler area for our family vacation this summer. The Premium Experiences team helped us plan perfect adventures for our family and took care of all the details, including last minute changes. From the recommendations and logistics, the team was always very responsive and offered so many additional services that would ensure an effortless vacation. We will definitely be back!

quotes.author: Andy Crimp
quotes.text: Premium Experiences took incredible care of us while we were in Whistler. Michelle and her team have great attention to detail, provide the most beautiful properties, and their understanding of hospitality made us feel very welcome. We will continue to use their services whenever we are visiting.Response from the owner1 year agoThank you Andy! It is a pleasure to host you, as always!

quotes.text: Beautiful chalet. Really well kept. Premium Experiences staff couldn’t have been more friendly, welcoming and helpful. Really impressed.
